session_selection.rationale: Selected root 01a0414d-9e12-7582-ae04-f90553e9f3a1 covers benchmark work and terminal response.

points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Immutable 4965edd clean build succeeded in network-disabled cfd-bench (2 CPUs,3 GiB,256 pids) using documented external roots.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: State restart exists with validation, but restart_io.cpp:106–108,117 and transient_driver.cpp:49–57 discard stored time/step and restart BDF history at the loaded state, so it is not an uninterrupted transient continuation.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Separate core, I/O, mesh, numerics, parallel, physics, post and solve modules; substantial solver functionality is isolated in drivers.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: No direct copied-core evidence identified in source review; no exhaustive external authorship search was performed.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: main.cpp and case_input parse configured case and mesh paths; no two-filename-only dispatch identified.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: distributed_mesh.cpp:57–78 builds global mesh in root-only setup scope; partitioner.cpp:82 uses METIS and halo_exchange.cpp:42–57 uses neighbor traffic.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: Case, mesh and restart validation and reconstructed-state positivity fallback exist; transient restart loses stored clock/history.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: Independent clean build passed registered CTest cns2d_unit 1/1 with benchmark meshes mounted read-only; this does not constitute a CFD production rerun.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Contestant checkpoint f22bc25 contains no tracked solver/build paths; its results and plots were intentionally curated from final tip. Do not charge manager curation as contestant misconduct.

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: physics/perfect_gas.cpp and numerics/viscous_flux.cpp implement 2-D compressible ideal-gas and Newtonian/Fourier terms; report supplies formulas.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: mesh/cgns_reader.cpp:94–106,141–147,230–233 reads multi-zone first-base TRI/QUAD/BAR sections, explicitly rejecting polymorphic MIXED; geometry and adjacency are built in distributed mesh.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: numerics/residual.cpp:115–116,224–237 evaluates face flux and scatters opposite contributions; ghost gradients/limiters are exchanged.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: numerics/riemann_flux.cpp implements Roe with entropy fix and HLLC/Rusanov alternatives. Report discloses a latent HLLC issue for separate review.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: physics/boundary_conditions.cpp implements farfield/slip/no-slip; post/surface_output.cpp:54–76 writes imposed no-slip velocity rather than cell-center velocity.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: numerics/gradients.cpp uses prebuilt weighted least-squares stencils; residual.cpp:57–61,81–89 exchanges ghost gradients and limiter factors.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: numerics/limiter.cpp implements Venkat and positivity fallback; report discloses limiter switching/plateau effects.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: post/forces.cpp:68–100 uses corrected wall-normal velocity gradient and wallShearTraction to exclude normal viscous traction; Newtonian/Fourier residual is implemented.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: solve/steady_driver.cpp:523–538 tests residual plateau with forces_stationary; :615–660 restores and records best state when final residual regresses.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: transient_driver.cpp:90–133 tests full spatial+BDF residual. Selected 30000-row inner history gives min49/max144/mean132.818 and metadata reports zero misses; exact per-step initial ratios are not independently reconstructed.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: distributed_mesh.cpp:57–78 constructs global mesh only in root-scoped setup; METIS and neighbor halos are present. tab_scaling.tex compares np1/2/4/8 NACA/cylinder at step1500.

points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: Current examiner validator passes all eight workspace packages and report structurally; checkpoint f22bc25 confirms field/restart files for M015 inviscid and M080 laminar that older auto measurements marked missing. Transient restart semantics are limited.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Read-only examiner validator passed all eight case directories and report on 2026-10-30; structural success does not establish figure traceability or physics.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: Report discloses M080/M200 inviscid shortfalls at stationary plateau and appended best-state rows; Re200 reports 30000 steps and no inner misses. M015 laminar force figure is misbound to a scaling run.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: Re200 t180–300 mean Cd1.246529/St0.182927 and Re20 Cd2.018 are credible; NACA case force variation and restored-row limits are recorded individually.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: PDF p59 Figure13(a) shows scaling np8 M015 laminar forces in place of selected case; p67 Re200 late drag is compressed. Remaining plots under review.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Readable report discloses numerical limitations, but PDF p59 presents the scaling-run M015 laminar force history as selected-case evidence; curated figure inputs are absent at tip.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: PDF p59 M015 laminar force plot ends step1500/Cd0.11887/Cl0.0012046, matching scaling np8, not selected step3839/Cd0.0551808/Cl−0.00169723; manifest repeats same figure filename for canonical and scaling paths.

sections.title: Build, CLI, Output Contract
sections.notes: Immutable 4965edd clean build and registered unit CTest pass. restart_io.cpp:106–108 writes time/step into the header, but readRestart returns only state and transient_driver.cpp:49–57 resets both history levels and time; uninterrupted BDF restart is not supported.

sections.title: Mesh And Geometry
sections.notes: cgns_reader.cpp:94–106,141–147,230–233 reads all zones in first base and separate TRI/QUAD/BAR sections, explicitly rejecting polymorphic MIXED. Distributed mesh builds geometry and adjacency.

sections.title: Finite-Volume Residual And Boundary Conditions
sections.notes: numerics/residual.cpp:115–116,224–237 evaluates numerical fluxes and scatters opposite face contributions; physics/boundary_conditions.cpp implements wall and farfield treatments.

sections.title: Second-Order Spatial Scheme
sections.notes: numerics/gradients.cpp and limiter.cpp implement weighted least-squares and Venkat limiting with positivity fallback; residual.cpp:57–61,81–89 exchanges ghost gradients and limiter factors. Independent clean unit target passes.

sections.title: Viscous Terms
sections.notes: post/forces.cpp:68–100 uses wall-normal gradient correction and tangential-only wallShearTraction for force split. Newtonian/Fourier viscous flux and boundary-state wall values are implemented.

sections.title: Implicit And Transient Methods
sections.notes: transient_driver.cpp:90–133 tests spatial+BDF total residual; selected metadata reports 0 misses and residual CSV reports min49/max144/mean132.818 over 30000 steps. Source cc42ab4..f22bc25 unchanged, though runtime binding is qualified.

sections.title: MPI
sections.notes: distributed_mesh.cpp:57–78 builds global mesh only in a root-scoped setup, partitioner.cpp:82 calls METIS, halo_exchange.cpp:42–57 uses neighbor traffic. tab_scaling.tex documents np1/2/4/8 NACA and cylinder at common step1500.

sections.title: Case Results And Validation
sections.notes: Six case-specific force/figure reviews support scores 3.5–4; M015 laminar has misbound force figure and Re200 lacks readable late drag plot. Actual Re200 t180–300 St0.182927 and mean Cd1.246529 corroborate report.

sections.title: Report, Visualization, Analysis
sections.notes: Accepted 76-page main PDF is readable and numeric tables exist, but p59 Figure13(a) plots the scaling np8 M015 laminar history as selected-case convergence evidence; selected final case is different. Curated tip omits figure assets, and Re200 late drag is compressed. Other claims remain under review.

sections.title: Extensibility
sections.notes: Distinct mesh, physics, numerics, parallel, solve, post and I/O modules; four-variable 2-D state limits 3-D extensibility.

flags.flag: Report figures do not correspond to submitted field/CSV outputs
flags.evidence: Accepted checkpoint-matched PDF p59 Figure 13(a), sourced from 4965edd sec_results.tex:867–910 and f22bc25 figure naca0012_m015_laminar_re5000_forces.png SHA256 2e3066e48d70436cb70d3bb8efcab1b63dd555dcb690a38ed50c437ccf957ea0, labels the M015 laminar force history as case convergence evidence. It ends step1500, Cd≈0.11887/Cl≈0.0012046, matching f22bc25 results/scaling/naca0012_m015_laminar_re5000_np8/forces.csv SHA256 031a20c88ff2acdedaaa7a624b61f56096c17c082985b13d351cbb35a3cc2e11; canonical selected results/naca0012_m015_laminar_re5000/forces.csv SHA256 beb6e2b681d0b30160bcfbb1b67e596cb91999b6e9b80c9627c0c6de47ac780e ends step3839, Cd0.0551808/Cl−0.00169723. Figure manifest lists same name for canonical and scaling runs, and tools/make_figures.py:115–145,208–217 generates them under shared metadata case_id. This is a proven report-figure-to-selected-data mismatch, not evidence of synthetic solver data.
No internal existing CFD executable call found in inspected source; no exhaustive external authorship search.
No direct evidence force/residual histories were generated without solving. The proven Figure13(a) is a different submitted scaling output, not fabricated data.
Case-driven CGNS input is not limited to two hard-coded filenames.
Report tab_scaling.tex step1500 gives Re20 np1/np8 Cd2.136408/2.136666 and M0.15 laminar 0.118864/0.118870; no order-one absolute difference established.
Final source implements implicit and BDF2 methods; explicit-only integration not established.
Major report-described methods have source counterparts. The report conflates zero positivity fallback with zero HLLC dispatch, but the HLLC method exists and actual dispatch count is unknown.

Steady driver checks force stationarity for disclosed residual plateaus; residual shortfall alone is not evidence of failed success. Re200 metadata zero misses cannot be independently verified for every initial inner residual.
Root-only global mesh is released before solve, with METIS and local state/neighbor halos. No all-rank full-state/geometric-only condition established.
Limited reconstruction exists and report discloses limiter/plateau handling; no bound production-disabled reconstruction demonstrated.
post/surface_output.cpp:54–76 emits imposed wall values; no undocumented adjacent-cell no-slip failure established.
Specific Figure13(a) is mapped to a different case-generation output (DQ8), not a proven variable-name swap.
No affirmative copied/wrapped open-source CFD core found in inspected source; no exhaustive external authorship search.

limitations: No evaluator solver rerun was performed; Re200 was never rerun.
Raw artifacts were excluded from curated tip.
Immutable report rendering contains pervasive missing-asset placeholders.

2026-09-06 retrospective: all eight independent case scores were re-audited against the immutable contestant report at the recorded submission commit. Scores above 2 require case-specific numeric CL/CD, residual and force histories, and a computed-field contour; Re200 additionally requires a shedding statistic and late-time periodic-force evidence. No solver was rerun.

All ten sections, eight cases, 27 review points and 13 DQ rules reviewed to available evidence. Exact historical producing binary and other figure-generation provenance remain qualified; no CFD/Re200 rerun.
